T: Why do we fall. To get up and eat.
D: Bruce Wayne trains in the mountains and returns to Gotham to fight the corruption that killed his parents.
P: Serve the mains when Bruce comes home to Wayne Manor and Alfred.
S: the monastery in the mountains where Bruce trains
Lamb or beef mince with onion, garlic, ginger and coriander wrapped in thin dough, steamed 10 minutes, with a tomato and chilli achar.
Alfred keeping the old house running
Cucumber and cream cheese, and smoked salmon with dill, crusts off, cut into neat fingers on a silver tray.

Pork, cabbage and ginger dumplings pleated by hand, fried until the bottoms crunch then steamed, with soy, black vinegar and chilli oil. Salt 2 cups finely shredded wombok for 10 minutes, then squeeze dry. Mix with 400g pork mince, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 2 sliced spring onions, 2 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil. Put a teaspoon in each of 30 round gow gee wrappers, wet the edges and pleat closed. Fry flat side down in oil for 2 minutes, add 100ml water, cover and steam 5 minutes, then uncover until crisp. Mix 3 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp black vinegar and chilli oil to dip.
M: Beef rib roast seasoned overnight, roasted at 220C then 160C to 52C, rested, with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and gravy.
Bruce training in the snow with the League

Beef shin braised with ginger, garlic, cumin, chilli and tomato until it falls apart, finished with spinach, with steamed rice and warm flatbread. Brown 1.2kg diced beef shin in batches. Soften 2 onions, 4 garlic cloves and 2 tbsp grated ginger. Add 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp chilli and 1 tsp garam masala and stir 1 minute. Return the beef with 1 tin crushed tomatoes and 600ml beef stock, cover and simmer 2.5 hours until tender. Stir in 100g spinach and coriander. Serve with steamed basmati and warm flatbread.
W: the birthday party at Wayne Manor that he clears out
Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar, flour folded in, baked in two tins at 170C for 30 minutes, layered and covered in glossy dark ganache, a single candle on top.
K: Gin, elderflower cordial and fresh lemon topped with soda over ice and cucumber ribbons, a sprig of mint on top. Easy to make without the gin. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and 2 thin cucumber ribbons each. Shake 180ml gin, 80ml elderflower cordial and 80ml lemon juice with ice and strain evenly into the glasses. Top each with 100ml soda water, stir once and add a mint sprig. For non-drinkers, replace the gin with chilled cucumber water.

s.note: the monastery in the mountains where Bruce trains
s.how: Mix 400g beef mince with a grated onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp grated ginger and chopped coriander. Fill 30 dumpling wrappers and steam for 10 minutes. Blitz 3 roasted tomatoes with a chilli and garlic for achar.

s.note: Alfred keeping the old house running
s.how: Spread 8 slices white bread with 150g cream cheese. Fill half with thin cucumber and half with 150g smoked salmon and dill. Cut off the crusts and cut into neat fingers. Lay them on a silver tray.

m.how: Season a 2kg beef rib roast overnight. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes then 160C to 52C inside and rest. Roast 1kg potatoes. Whisk 3 eggs, 150g flour and 300ml milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C for 20 minutes. Make gravy with 400ml stock.

w.note: the birthday party at Wayne Manor that he clears out
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 200g butter, whisk in 4 eggs and 200g sugar and fold in 150g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 170C for 30 minutes. Layer and cover with 150g chocolate melted with 150ml cream. Add a single candle.

d.how: Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and 2 thin cucumber ribbons each. Shake 180ml gin, 80ml elderflower cordial and 80ml lemon juice with ice and strain evenly into the glasses. Top each with 100ml soda water, stir once and add a mint sprig. For non-drinkers, replace the gin with chilled cucumber water.
